Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a blooming lavender field in neat rows under a clear sky with a gravel path, a wooden gate and fence of normal height, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Senegalese man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a fresh-faced boy-group idol face with clear glowing skin, bright eyes and a gentle smile line, clean-shaven, metallic gold glitter eyeshadow with defined lashes, deep blue-black skin with a smooth sheen, a cool composed look, deep jet-black with a glossy sheen hair styled in cornrows braided tight against the scalp, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large silver hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a tin hammer head, a silver teardrop-shaped sinker), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large silver hoop carrying six heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a silver miniature anvil, a silver square-sided cowbell, an iron hammer head, a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a tin round bell, a silver cube-shaped block), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three rose-gold anklets. Extremely long almond nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.

Broad shoulders, a full athletic chest, a lean defined abdomen with a clear eight-pack, strong toned arms, a narrow waist, and long strong toned legs with defined calves. Large and powerful in frame, yet taut, lean and elegant rather than bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a black ninja headband with a polished steel plate across his forehead, black fingerless wrist wraps, and a minimal black T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him tied with a red sash at the hip, his chest and stomach bare.

Enormously broad shoulders with round capped deltoids, a wide upper chest tapering sharply to a very narrow waist in a dramatic V-taper, a lean sharply defined six-pack abdomen with visible obliques, thick strong arms, and long lean athletic legs that are muscular but not bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing glossy red boxing gloves and a minimal red satin T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel and a thin gold-edged white waistband strap, on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his whole chest and stomach bare.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.
